build_RecurrentAgent: build a recurrent A2C agent with an action model and critic model for reinforcement learning
create_ActionModel: create an action model with an RNN cell that outputs action probabilities from observation frames
create_CriticModel: create a critic model that computes state value V(s) from hidden state and observation frames
test_RecurrentAgent_call_replay: test the RecurrentAgent call_replay method to verify action probabilities match stored trajectory data
refactor_ActionModel_forward: refactor the ActionModel forward pass to support custom activation functions or additional input features
